findings.title: Dr. Ada transitions to full-time VA primary care physician on Saipan
findings.exact_supporting_passage: the clinic will be closed from October 30 to November 3
findings.territory: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands
findings.service_line: primary care / outpatient clinic (Medical Associates of the Pacific, LLC)
findings.access_consequences: Clinic states it will be closed October 30-November 3, 2026, while moving to the MH-1 Building next door. Short-term interruption of local clinic visits is expected; article says nurse practitioners and other clinicians will continue afterward. No evidence of permanent clinic closure. Dr. Ada is moving to full-time VA primary care; impact on her previous private-practice panel is not quantified.
findings.affected_population: Medical Associates of the Pacific patients in Saipan; number of affected visits/patients unknown.
findings.timing_note: Source provides the calendar date but not publication time. Treat as same-day recall, not proof of announcement after the prior hourly heartbeat.
